inline_obligation.subject: User harm begins at 70% utilization under the frozen case conditions.

dependencies.rationale: The empirical onset assertion is distinct from the prospective stopping rule and supplies its stated justification. Removing it would change the claim's meaning from an empirically justified threshold to a threshold choice. No separate frozen claim evaluates this assertion.

embedded_classifications.subject: User harm begins at 70% utilization under the frozen case conditions.
embedded_classifications.rationale: This asserts an empirical state of affairs at a specific utilization level without framing that assertion as a derivation from evidence. Its role as a reason for the rule does not itself make it an inference.
